name: Reflex
summary: A deliberately simple general-purpose humanoid from New York's Reflex Robotics: two arms and a height-adjustable torso on a wheeled base, with remote human supervision and learning-based autonomy for picking, tote handling and palletising. Skipping legs keeps it cheap and reliable; GXO has run it in operational warehouse tests.
notable: Wheeled, legless design for low cost and uptime

sources.title: GXO begins operational testing of Reflex Robotics humanoid — The Robot Report
